snippet.title: Dead Reckoning - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Dead Reckoning is a 2D pixel action game that mixes old-school, boss-focused side-scrolling with fast, modern dash combat. Play a retired, reluctant warrior fighting through a dark cyber-fantasy world to recover a stolen artifact and uncover its hidden secret. 

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5371410/Dead_Reckoning/

Developer: Middle_Aged_Dad
